entries.claim: Per-EXPERT activation statistics beat pooled ones for scale fitting, at identical bytes. Pooled weighting is WORSE than no weighting at all.

architecture_condition.requires: routed mixture-of-experts; the statistic must be accumulated per routed expert id

entries.measurement: 3 classes, always at identical byte cost: plain binary -7.1% and -10.3% ppl, residual binary -11.7%. Pooled: +1.9%, +1.0% (worse than uncalibrated).
entries.oracle_strength: strong: 5 paired comparisons, byte-identical arms, deterministic ppl
entries.reopen_condition: a routed MoE where pooled >= per-expert at equal bytes
entries.why_it_should_transfer: it follows from ROUTING: each expert sees a different token sub-distribution, so a pooled statistic mismatches the parameter it weights

entries.claim: Routing frequency does NOT predict representational importance. Rarely-routed experts are not safe to compress. Allocate by sensitivity, never by traffic.
entries.measurement: Exact equal-byte control at 3.2830765066781096 EBPW: uniform q3-g128 PASSES (ppl 3.135, 4-gram 0.1075); hot/cold 4-bit on the busiest half and 2-bit on the rest FAILS (ppl 3.070, 4-gram 0.5806) despite BETTER perplexity. Routing is genuinely skewed (top-8 of 64 take 37.5% vs a uniform 12.5%), so the skew is real and is the wrong axis.
entries.oracle_strength: strong: byte-identical to 16 digits, both terms of the gate measured
entries.reopen_condition: an MoE where a traffic-proportional budget beats a uniform one at equal bytes on BOTH gate terms

entries.claim: Below roughly 4-bit weights, decode stops being bandwidth-bound, so further byte reduction buys no decode speed.
entries.measurement: bf16 achieves 452.2 GB/s = 56.5% of peak; q4/q3/q2 achieve 185.6/170.1/144.3 GB/s = 23.2/21.3/18.0%. Decode tok/s saturates: q4 127.48, q2 128.97, ranges overlap.
entries.oracle_strength: strong: 6-repeat warm medians with spread reported; earlier 2-repeat figures were low by up to 35% and are superseded
entries.reopen_condition: a body on this host where decode scales with bytes below q4

entries.claim: For a top-k MoE, expert matmuls are a MINORITY of a quantized decode step, so all representation work is capped at a small decode speedup. Attention and the router/gather/combine path dominate.
entries.measurement: Verified ablation at seq=1 over 40 decode steps: expert matmuls 17.4%, router+gather+combine 28.2%, attention 40.8%. Ceilings if each were FREE: experts 1.21x, router 1.39x, attention 1.69x.
entries.oracle_strength: strong: every ablation gated on changing the output logits; an earlier instance-level patch measured 0% and was rejected
entries.reopen_condition: an MoE on this host where expert matmuls exceed half the step

architecture_condition.requires: top-k routing; a dense body has no expert gather to amortise

entries.claim: A capability gate scored on perplexity alone will pass a model that cannot generate. The gate needs a generation term and >= 8 prompts.
entries.measurement: 5 measured dissociations on one specimen, including ppl 4.085 (only 41% above the bf16 reference) while emitting 87 consecutive identical tokens. An n=1 coherence verdict of 0.000 became 0.6398 at n=8.
entries.oracle_strength: strong: 5 independent instances; mechanism identified (teacher forcing conditions on ground truth and cannot see error compounding)
entries.reopen_condition: a specimen where ppl and generation never dissociate across 10+ representations

entries.claim: O003's lowest capability-preserving representation is q3-g128-experts at 3.2831 complete EBPW; its non-expert organ is an irreducible 0.4318 EBPW floor.
entries.measurement: 22 points across 8 classes; 3 pass. Non-expert reduction fails at 3b/g128 (ppl 3.714) and 4b/g128 (4-gram 0.2903), and destroys at 2b/g128 (ppl 19398).
entries.oracle_strength: strong for this body; says nothing about another
entries.reopen_condition: any calibrated or fine-tuned method reaching the gate below 3.2831

entries.claim: O003's 64 experts per layer carry no shared linear structure: shared-basis, clustered dictionary, low-rank-across-experts and cross-expert sharing are all dead.
entries.measurement: Centred Gram spectrum over 12 probes: k90 = 56-57 of 64. NULL control of 64 independent gaussians gives k90 = 56. Indistinguishable.
entries.oracle_strength: strong within layers; does NOT test cross-layer, nonlinear, or post-permutation-alignment structure
entries.reopen_condition: a spectrum probe after permutation alignment, or across layers
